about_the_game:
Catboy Sorcery is a cute and sexy romance visual novel about a tailor and a mischievous accomplice. 

You’re a magical tailor with big dreams, impeccable stitching, and bills to pay. The goal? Join a prestigious merchant guild, land elite clients, and finally get the recognition and paycheck you deserve.

But in this world, magic alone isn’t enough. You can sew spells into silk, but a true Guilds won’t look twice at a mage without a familiar, and without guild backing, high-paying clients won’t even step through your door.

The solution is simple. Get a familiar. Fast. It doesn’t have to be a perfect bond. It doesn’t even have to be permanent. You just need someone, anyone, magical and willing enough to stand by your side.

Features

🧵 Customizable MC

Choose your name, pronouns (he, she, or they), and shape your personality—sweet, teasing, or cold. Your choices define your dynamic with your charmingly cursed companion.

🐾 One Mischievous Catboy

He’s flirty, confident, and absolutely not what you were looking for. But he’s powerful, and somehow the magic works. Will you be able to romance him?

🎩Fulfill Desires and Increase Reputation

Every customer who walks through your door, has a wish to fulfill. The trick is to convince them that only you can do it. Satisfy your customers and build a reputation. 

🎨 Gorgeous Original Art

Handcrafted by a small, but passionate team.

content_descriptors.notes: Catboy Sorcery is intended to be cute in theme and does not feature explicit content. There are however suggestive jokes and/or outfits.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5 x64
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX or AMD Radeon
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: You just wanted a familiar to join a mage guild. Instead, you got a flirty, cursed catboy with trust issues. Now he says he can help you, if you help him. Can you trust him? Probably. (Send help.) Make the right choices in this cute ALL x Catboy romance visual novel.
